findings.summary: Semantic equality deletes user-controlled attributes whose names collide with positional metadata names.
Oracle-independence dependency scanning covers only one of five packet-declared generated oracles.
Compact emission does not exclude a literal equal to the explicit-dialect sentinel.
Declared killing tests do not substantively distinguish the mutant's constant-empty behavior.
Qualified markdown cells can drift from underlying evidence while retaining valid shape and packet digest.
